Metadata.name: mamacrochet
Metadata.title: Handmade crochet, made with love — just for you
Metadata.description: Handmade crochet bags and cozy little pieces, crafted one stitch at a time. Dreaming of something specific? Chat with us and we'll make it — no account needed to start.

IntroBar.title: Every piece is handmade, to order
IntroBar.body: start in chat — no account needed, pay only when it's ready

Works.title: Works made with love
Works.subtitle: Our most-loved pieces — the ones ordered most and rated highest
Works.allSubtitle: Everything mama has made — filter by category, then take your favorite into the chat
Works.endOfList: That's the whole collection — every piece made with love.

CustomOffer.title: Didn't find your liking?
CustomOffer.body: Send Mama an idea, a sketch or a photo — she crochets almost anything, just for you. No account needed to start.

ChatPanel.label: Chat with Mama
ChatPanel.title: Mama
ChatPanel.opener: Hi, sweetheart! 👋 I'm Mama. What shall we make together today?
ChatPanel.pickerEmpty: No works match — tell Mama your idea, she can make it!
ChatPanel.railHint: Tap to add to the chat — or drag a card in.
ChatPanel.railFoot: Or browse the full list — every piece can be yours.
ChatPanel.statusLive: Online — usually replies in a few minutes
ChatPanel.statusPolling: Reconnecting — messages continue via backup line
ChatPanel.closedBanner: This conversation is closed. Need anything else? Start a new chat.
ChatPanel.emptyThread: No messages yet — say hi to Mama!

Chat.listHint: Your chats with Mama live here — one per order, plus your first chat.
Chat.listEmpty: No conversations yet — start a chat with Mama!

Join.title: Join the team
Join.pitch: We're a small crew of makers who crochets with love. If your hands know the rhythm of a crochet hook, we'd love to meet you — tell us about yourself and your work below.
Join.formBody: The maker reads every application personally. One application per email — re-applying simply updates yours.
Join.name: Your name
Join.previousWorkPlaceholder: What you've made, where you've worked, how long you've been crocheting…
Join.messagePlaceholder: Anything else you'd like us to know…
Join.filesHint: Up to 3 photos or PDFs (JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF), 10 MB each.
Join.filesTooMany: You can attach up to 3 files.
Join.fileBadType: Use a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo, or a PDF.
Join.errorRequired: Please fill in your name, email, phone, country, at least one language, and a few words about your work.
Join.successBody: Thank you for reaching out — the maker reads every application personally and will get in touch. We can't wait to see what you make.

AdminHiring.declineBody: The application is closed. In release 1 you reach the applicant by phone — no email is sent.
AdminHiring.notePlaceholder: e.g. We're fully staffed for now…
AdminHiring.forbiddenBody: You're signed in, but this desk is for admins.
